items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: INTERVIEWER: What was Fest's brother's name, do you remember? INTERVIEWEE: Well, John, he used to call him John, Fest's brother.

ctx.x: What was Fest's brother's name, do you remember?
Well, John, he used to call him John, Fest's brother. John? John, they used to call him. John. John, yeah. John. John. But I don't think he ever played any music, I don't think.
But he could, he was real bright, huh?
